content.short: Spindl is the first real way to do measurement and attribution in web3.
content.description: Spindl, founded in 2022 by Antonio Garcia Martinez, is a pre-product venture pursuing the first attribution platform tailored for web3. The project envisions helping protocols, DAOs, and other organizations identify metrics that signal a project's health, success, or potential problems. Developers can use Spindl's early offerings to gain deeper insights into their user base, community dynamics, and overall ecosystem, paving the way for more informed decision-making as the platform evolves.
